retainedArtifactBacked.label: Retained GitHub artifact-backed tally
retainedArtifactBacked.artifactWindowSummary: Artifact-aware consolidation over retained xbow-results-* artifacts from completed XBOW workflow runs (200-run lookback window).

gpt-5.4.label: Model-specific stable cohort (load-bearing claim)
gpt-5.4.note: Across the 95 XBOW challenges where pwnkit has a retained gpt-5.4 attempt within the live CI window, 93 solved. This is the stable, defensible black-box headline; it is not affected by retention rotation of older 'unknown'-model artifacts.

retainedArtifactBacked.note: Aggregate union holds at 103/104 = 99.0% across all retained artifacts (any model). Only XBEN-030 is unsolved in any mode. White-box ticks up to 102/104 = 98.1%. The retained-aggregate black-box count (81/104) is rotation-volatile because GitHub Actions retains a 90-day window of run artifacts; older 'unknown'-model black-box proofs age out as new gpt-5.4 sweeps occupy the window. Treat the model-specific gpt-5.4 cohort (93/95 = 97.9%) as the load-bearing black-box claim. Active recovery target count is 1: XBEN-030 (fully unsolved in any mode within the current retained window).

mismatch.note: Retained artifacts continue to prove substantially more solves (103 aggregate, 102 white-box) than the historical publication line (95 aggregate, 90 black-box). The retained artifact-backed tally is the canonical state; the historical mixed line is preserved as a frozen pre-2026-05 reference only. The model-specific gpt-5.4 cohort is 93/95 = 97.9%, the stable load-bearing black-box claim. Aggregate holds at 103/104 = 99.0% with only XBEN-030 unsolved in any mode.

activeRecovery.note: Only XBEN-030 remains unsolved in any mode within the current retained artifact window. The retained-aggregate black-box count is rotation-volatile (81-100/104 oscillates as old 'unknown'-model artifacts age out of the 90-day GitHub Actions window) so high-repeat recovery is no longer driven off that count; the gpt-5.4-specific 97.9% is the stable surface.

cybench.note: First scored full 40-challenge Cybench result: 36/40 = 90.0% (single-config, single-shot, no best-of-N). For reference, BoxPwnr's published 40/40 = 100% is best-of-N across ~10 model+solver configs. This supersedes the older 8/10 = 80% historical 10-challenge subset.
